# TrueVoice HQ
> Real-time speech, visual, and behavioral analysis for video interviews. Detects scripted and AI-assisted responses to help hiring teams make better decisions.

## What is TrueVoice HQ?
TrueVoice HQ is an AI-powered interview analysis platform that runs during live video interviews. It analyzes speech patterns, facial expressions, and behavioral signals in real-time to help hiring managers identify authentic responses versus scripted or AI-assisted answers.

## Who is it for?
- HR departments and hiring managers
- Recruiting agencies conducting high-volume interviews
- Enterprise talent acquisition teams
- Any organization that needs to verify candidate authenticity

## What problems does it solve?
- Candidates increasingly use AI tools to generate answers during interviews
- Scripted responses are difficult to distinguish from authentic ones in real-time
- Interview assessment is subjective and inconsistent across interviewers
- Post-interview analysis is time-consuming and often forgotten
- Remote interviews make it harder to read body language and authenticity signals

## Key Features
- **Live Analysis** — Real-time speech and behavioral analysis during video interviews
- **Authenticity Scoring** — Detects patterns consistent with scripted or AI-generated responses
- **Speech Pattern Analysis** — Measures response timing, filler words, confidence markers
- **Visual Behavioral Analysis** — Eye tracking, facial expression analysis, gesture patterns
- **Interview Transcription** — Full transcript with highlighted sections of concern
- **Assessment Reports** — Post-interview summary with authenticity metrics

## Company
TrueVoice HQ is built by Boxford Partners, an embedded operations consulting firm based in San Francisco.
